author: sjm41
body:
* **PTHR ID & PTN node:**
PTN001659973 (PTHR11140)

* **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**
Human ADTRP (Q96IZ2) & AIG1 (Q9NVV5)


This is just an FYI:
This node (and the two source genes) are currently annotated with the high-level 'hydrolase activity' term. I'm creating a more specific term in https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/31722, so we should be able to switch the source annotations and this node to use that new term presently.
title: PAINT issue: PTN001659973 (PTHR11140)

author: marcfeuermann
body: Thanks for the information. We will come back to this one once the term will be available.

author: sjm41
body:
FYI, I've now annotated the 2 human genes, ADTRP (Q96IZ2) & AIG1 (Q9NVV5), with the new GO term GO:0120573
FAHFA hydrolase activity from PMID:27018888.
The new annotations are now in the P2GO tool, but I don't know when it will be available for PAINTing....

author: marcfeuermann
body: Great, thanks a lot. I can create new annotations on my end, but it’s true that if the term is too new, it won’t be available to me for that purpose either. The ticket has been tagged, and I’ll check back on it from time to time :-)

author: marcfeuermann
body: This is in fact PTHR10989. But it's okay. The annotation is available now and the changes are done. Thanks.
